title: Find the Maximum Sequence Value of Array
summary: Given an integer array nums and a positive integer k, determine the highest value of any subsequence of nums with a size of 2 * k.
statement: Given an integer array nums and a positive integer k, determine the highest value of any subsequence of nums with a size of 2 * k. The value of a sequence seq of length 2 * x is calculated as the bitwise OR of the first x elements XOR the bitwise OR of the last x elements.
constraints: Choose a length-2k subsequence; OR its first k values and OR its last k values.
Return the maximum XOR of those two OR results.
hints: Only selected count and accumulated 7-bit OR matter on either side of a split.
Build reachable OR sets for choosing up to k values in every prefix and suffix.
For each valid split, XOR every reachable k-choice prefix OR with every k-choice suffix OR.
Every ordered subsequence has a unique split between its kth and k+1st selections, so the scan is complete.
editorial: Every ordered subsequence has a unique split between its kth and k+1st selections, so the scan is complete.

tests.explanation: The subsequence 4,5,6,7 gives (4 OR 5) XOR (6 OR 7) = 2.
